ambiguities: A-VALUATION-01: intrinsic-value claims must be representable as expressed claims without declaring their truth merely the valuer's preference; normative stance unresolved.
A-VALUATION-02: exchange,welfare,reported preference and nonmonetary importance cannot be silently converted or totaled.
A-VALUATION-03: no universal HighRisk,Safe,Valuable or Sustainable predicate. A comparison rule,viewpoint and scenario are required.
A-VALUATION-04: existing valuation imports obsolete decision. Remove/replace dependency in a separately reviewed executable edit after reference audit; this dossier does not retain decision.
A-VALUATION-05: risk as potential-loss meaning differs from existing configuration formalization; align or deliberately break with source-backed explanation.
A-VALUATION-06: IPBES full chapters and SEEA Annex12.1 not completely read; exact detailed taxonomy,exchange/welfare distinctions and expert disagreements remain review gates.
A-VALUATION-07: damage and asset cessation belong to imported physical occurrences; do not embed value change in a valuation model without an explicit occurrence.
